purpose: Explicit interpretations needed to implement Min-Max and Pay Period One/Zero v1 from John's original source documents.

OZ-01.decision: Generate the twelve One/Zero month targets from the approved benchmark fiscal window, August 2023 through July 2024, rather than the example years printed in the source documents.
OZ-01.falsified_by: John's Access run uses another twelve-month matrix window.

OZ-02.decision: Min-Max coverage uses earliest included PPS through latest included PPE per employee, unit, and FEIN; source-document references to first/last paycheck date are treated as imprecise labels for the period range.
OZ-02.falsified_by: John's diagram or Access matrix uses paycheck dates rather than PPS/PPE boundaries.

OZ-03.decision: Pay Period coverage uses PPS <= month target <= PPE. The source condition PaycheckDate <= target AND PaycheckDate >= target is treated as a wording defect because it reduces to equality and conflicts with the period-range examples.
OZ-03.falsified_by: John confirms equality-to-paycheck-date or another coverage rule.

OZ-04.decision: For Month 12, when the employee's last PPE is in Month 12 and day > 15, use that PPE as the target; otherwise use month end.
OZ-04.falsified_by: A later John-authored flow supersedes the original Month-12 rule.

OZ-05.decision: Pay Period One/Zero consumes only periods classified as major within source cadence. Until John supplies the exact classifier, use the current median-employee-count/2 cadence heuristic and expose every classification and missing-period flag.
OZ-05.falsified_by: John supplies a different major-period classifier or Access period list.

OZ-06.decision: No employee may contribute more than one count in a month. Flag every overlap before correction; v1 assigns the count to the covering row with the latest PPS, then latest PPE, then stable source order, and records before/after disposition.
OZ-06.falsified_by: John supplies another test-of-twos allocation rule or a manual disposition.

OZ-07.decision: For this full-year benchmark, divide unit total by 12. Preserve the unrounded audit average, expose the source-document nearest-whole half-up view, and keep the application's two-decimal value as a distinct field.
OZ-07.falsified_by: John uses a partial-year month denominator, another rounding sequence, or only one output precision.

OZ-08.decision: Eligibility remains customer-wide; One/Zero matrix grain includes employee, unit, and FEIN. Unit determines legal entity for this source unless an exception is flagged.
OZ-08.falsified_by: John's Access output uses another legal-entity allocation grain.

OZ-09.decision: Min-Max emits one row per eligible employee-unit-FEIN span; Pay Period emits one row per eligible employee-major-period-unit-FEIN.
OZ-09.falsified_by: John's follow-up changes the documented matrix grain.

change_control.supersession_rule: Create a new versioned file when John clarifies an ambiguity; retain this v1 with all runs that used it.
